info.title: VSX
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [VSX](#/VSX)
VSX configuration and status. If not configured, VSX functionality is disabled.

config_sync_disable.description: Specifies whether the VSX configuration synchronization is enabled or not.

config_sync_features.description: Feature configurations to be globally synchronized between VSX peers: `aaa`:                  Everything related to aaa. `acl-log-timer`:        Everything related to access-list log timer. 'arp-security' :        ARP SECURITY feature. `bfd-global`:           Enable, disable and remove bfd, enable and disable bfd echo,                         configure transmit and receive intervals, detect multiplier, etc. `bgp`:                  BGP, ip aspath list, community list, prefix list,                         route map configurations. `client-track-ip`:      Global configurations for client IP tracker. `control-plane-acls`:   Control-plane Access-lists `copp-policy`:          CoPP policies. `dcb-global`:           Global configurations for features related to                          Data Center Bridging (DCBx, PFC and ETS).                         Only applicable to 8325 platforms. `dhcp-relay`:           Everything related to DHCP relay. `dhcp-server`:          Everything related to DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 server. `dhcp-snooping`:        Everything related to DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 snooping. `dns`:                  Name servers, host names, etc. `dsm`:                  Distributed services module associated with VRF. `evpn`:                 EVPN related configurations. `firewall-mode`:     Firewall Mode related configurations. `forwarding-mode-global`: forwarding-mode related global configuration. `gbp`:                  gbp related configuration `gbp-acl-global`:       gbp acl applied to global context `hardware-high-capacity-tcam`: Feature configured in high capacity TCAM `ip-ecmp`               Configurations related to IP ECMP `icmp-tcp`:             Configurations related to ICMP and TCP. `internal-vlan-range`:  Configurations related to internal VLAN range. `keychain`:       Everything related to keychain configurations. `l2-vlan-mac-cfg-mode`: L2 VLAN MAC configuration mode.                         Only applicable to 8320 and 8325 platforms. `lldp`:                 Everything related to LLDP. `loop-protect-global`:  Loop-protect global configurations. `mac-lockout`:          mac lockout configurations. `macsec`:           Configurations related to MACsec. `mclag-interfaces`:     Features on multi-chassis LAGs that have to be identical on                         both peers: QoS, LACP, Loop-Protect, LAG description,                         sFlow, STP, Rate-Limits, Vlans, ACLs, etc. `mgmd-global`:          Sync MGMD global configurations. `msdp-global`:          Sync MSDP global configurations. `nd-snooping` :         Everything related to ND snooping. `neighbor` :            Everything related to IPv4 and IPv6 neighbors mostly static neighbors `ospf`:                 OSPF, route map and keychain configurations. `pim`:          Configurations related to PIM. `policy-global`:        Classifier policy applied to the global context. `private-vlan-global`:  Private VLAN global configuration. `rip`:              Everything related to RIP and RIPng configurations. `qos-global`:           DSCP-Maps, CoS-Maps, QoS-Trust. `route-map`:            IP aspath list, community list, prefix list,                         route map configurations. `sflow-global`:         Everything related to sFlow. `snmp`:                 SNMPv3 contexts, SNMPv3 users, SNMP traps, SNMP communities, etc. `ssh`:                  Secure shell configurations. `static-routes`:        Static routes. `stp-global`:           Global (not per-interface) STP configurations. `telnet`:               Telnet server configurations. `time`:                 Everything related to time - NTP, time zone, etc. `udp-forwarder`:        UDP forwarder feature. `vrrp`:                 VRRP configurations, except anything realted to BFD. `vsx-global` :          Sync inter-switch-link timers, Keepalive timers,                         keepalive udp-port, system-mac, split-recovery and                         linkup delay timer. `port-access`:           Configurations related to port-access.

device_role.description: Specifies whether the device will act as primary or secondary for VSX. VSX operation requires one peer switch to be primary and the other secondary. If not configured, then the device will not participate in VSX role election.

isl_last_disconnect.description: Time in seconds since Epoch when the ISL session was last  disconnected after having been established prior to the  disconnection. If not set, the ISL connection was either not  established since boot or was established and not  disconnected subsequently.

isl_last_established.description: Time in seconds since Epoch when ISL connection was last  established. When not set, it means ISL connection has not  been established since the device booted up.

isl_mgmt_statistics.description: Accounts for CLI connectivity to the peer database, REST forwarding, NAE communication, etc.

rx_drops.description: Number of ISL mgmt packets drops.

rx_pkts.description: Number of ISL mgmt packets received.

tx_pkts.description: Number of ISL mgmt packets transmitted.

isl_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
References port to be used as inter switch link. If not configured, then the device will not participate in VSX formation.

hello_rx.description: Number of ISLP hello packets received.

hello_tx.description: Number of ISLP hello packets transmitted.

hold_time.description: Configures ISL port-flap hold time in seconds.

peer_detect_interval.description: Configures the amount of time in seconds that the device will wait  for ISL interface to link up after a reboot. If the ISL link does  not come up within this time window, the device will declare  itself as split from its peer.

timeout.description: Configures the amount of time to wait for hellos from peer in seconds.

keepalive_last_established.description: Stores the most recent time when keepalive handshake was successful. time stored is epoch time and empty value indicates keepalive handshake has never been established.

keepalive_last_failed.description: Stores the most recent time when keepalive handshake failed. time stored is epoch time and empty value indicates keepalive handshake has never been failed.

keepalive_peer_ip.description: IPv4/IPv6 address of the peer device. If not configured, keepalive functionality is disabled.

keepalive_peer_status.description: Peer switch attributes determined by keepalive protocol.

peer_islp_state.description: Peer switch ISL protocol state detected by keepalive protocol.

peer_system_id.description: Peer system ID detected by keepalive protocol. It is used when ISL is not operational.

keepalive_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
Specifies L3 port for keepalive [Port](#/Port).

keepalive_src_ip.description: IPv4/IPv6 address of the device. If not configured, keepalive functionality is disabled.

dead_interval_timeout.description: Number of times keepalive packet has not been received before expiration of dead interval.

dead_interval.description: Configures the amount of time to wait for keepalive packets from a peer in seconds.

keepalive_udp_port.description: UDP port number of peer device.

keepalive_vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF to be used for keepalive routing. If not configured, then the default VRF is used.

last_sync_timestamp.description: Specifies the time (in seconds from epoch) of the last configuration synchronization.

linkup_delay_timer.description: Number of seconds that multi-chassis LAGs should be held down after the ISL is considered to be fully established and VSX switches are synchronized. Comes into effect on new ISL deployments, ISL flaps or full device reboot.

linkup_delay_timer_start_time.description: Time (in seconds from Epoch), at which the currently running linkup delay timer started. Empty if the timer is not running.

oper_status.description: Specifies the operational status of the different VSX components  and the summarized state of the VSX system.

config_sync_state.description: Specifies state of the feature VSX configuration synchronization. `in-sync`:                              Feature is operational. `disabled`:                             Feature is disabled. `sw_image_version_mismatch_error`:      Software image on the primary device                                         does not match with the software image                                         on the secondary device. `conflicting_or_missing_device_roles`:  Either the role is missing on                                         one of the VSX peers or the same                                         role is configured on both. `peer_db_connection_error`:             Error in connecting to peer database.                                         It involves errors due to                                         Inter-Switch-Link or                                         Inter-Switch-Link mgmt. `configuration_sync_conflict`:          Feature is operational but has conflicts                                         synchronizing configuration.                                         Conflicts can occur if the configuration                                         on the primary device is marked for sync                                         but the same configuration on the                                         secondary device is not marked for sync. `configuration_sync_missing_reference`: Feature is operational but has missing                                         references in synchronizing configuration

device_role.description: Specifies the actual role of the device in a VSX system. Operational role generally matches the one that is  configured. However, the role might be different when  peers are disconnected or recovering from the lack of  connectivity. `primary`  :   Represents operational primary role `secondary`:   Represents operational secondary role

https_server_state.description: Specifies https-server state. `peer_reachable`:                       The peer device is reachable. `peer_unreachable`:                     The peer device is unreachable. `sw_image_version_mismatch_error`:      Software image version does not match                                         with the software image version on the                                         peer device. `internal_error`:                       Internal https-server error.

isl_mgmt_state.description: Specifies state of mgmt Inter-Switch-Link. Inter-Switch-Link mgmt data includes CLI connectivity to the peer database, REST forwarding, NAE communication, etc. `operational`:                         Inter-Switch-Link mgmt is operational. `inter_switch_link_mgmt_init`:         Inter-Switch-Link mgmt is in initialization                                        state. `conflicting_or_missing_device_roles`: Either the role is missing on                                        one of the VSX peers or the same                                        role is configured on both. `sw_image_version_mismatch_error`:     Software image on the primary device                                        does not match with the software image on                                        the secondary device. `inter_switch_link_down`:              Inter-Switch-Link is down. `internal_error`:                      Inter-Switch-Link mgmt has internal errors.

islp_device_state.description: Specifies the overall ISL protocol state of the VSX device. `waiting_for_peer`:            Waiting for connectivity to the peer. `peer_established`:            Steady state. VSX LAGs are up when the device is                                 in this state. `split_system_primary`:        Lost ISL connectivity to the peer and the device                                 is operating as primary.                                VSX LAGs are up when the device is in this state `split_system_secondary`:      Lost ISL connectivity to the peer and the device                                 is operating as secondary.                                VSX LAGs are down when the device is in this state. `sync_primary`:                ISL connectivity to the peer restored and                                 the device is syncing states to the peer.                                VSX LAGs are up when the device is in this state `sync_secondary`:              ISL connectivity to the peer restored and                                 the device is learning states from the peer.                                VSX LAGs are down when the device is in this state. `sync_secondary_linkup_delay`: Device has learned its states from the peer                                 and monitoring for hardware to be programmed.                                VSX LAGs are down when the device is in this state.

islp_link_state.description: Interswitch link state: `init`:         Initial state. `out_of_sync`:  ISLP link is not established. `in_sync`:      ISLP link is established. `in_sync_hold`: ISLP link is down and hold-timer is running.

nae_state.description: Specifies NAE state. `peer_reachable`:                       The peer device is reachable for                                         NAE agents. `peer_unreachable`:                     The peer device is unreachable for                                         NAE agents. `sw_image_version_mismatch_error`:      Software image version does not match                                         with the software image version on the                                         peer device.

overall_state.description: Specifies overall state of VSX feature. `operational`:                           VSX is operational without errors. `inter_switch_link_down`:                Inter-Switch-Link is down. `conflicting_or_missing_device_roles`:   Either the role is missing on                                          one of the VSX peers or the same                                          role is configured on both. `inter_switch_link_mgmt_down`:           Inter-Switch-Link mgmt is down. `inter_switch_link_mgmt_internal_error`: Inter-Switch-Link mgmt has internal                                          errors. `sw_image_version_mismatch_error`:       Software image on the primary device                                          does not match with the software image                                          on the secondary device. `peer_db_connection_error`:              Error in connecting to the peer database. `configuration_sync_conflict`:           VSX is operational but has conflicts in                                          synchronizing configuration. `configuration_sync_missing_reference`:  VSX is operational but has missing                                          references in synchronizing configuration.

hello_interval.description: ISL hello-interval configured on the peer device.

hold_time.description: ISL hold-interval configured on the peer device.

timeout.description: ISL dead-interval configured on the peer device.

peer_isl_vlan_list.description: List of VLANs that the peer device's ISL in a member of.

dead_interval.description: Keepalive dead interval configured on the peer device.

hello_interval.description: Keepalive hello interval configured on the peer device.

peer_keepalive_udp_port.description: Keepalive UDP port number configured on the peer device.

last_reboot_time.description: Specifies the time (in seconds from epoch) when VSX peer switch has rebooted.

peer_device_role.description: Specifies the peer switch's role in VSX operation.

peer_isl_port.description: Name of the logical port on the peer switch configured as ISL port.

peer_islp_version.description: ISL protocol version of the peer switch.

peer_ready.description: Status of the peer VSX switch. The MAC addresses, ARP entries, etc. are synced to the peer and the VSX is now operational.

peer_system_id.description: Specifies the user configured system id of the peer VSX switch.

peer_system_mac.description: Specifies the system mac of the peer VSX switch.

peer_sw_version.description: Software version running on the peer device.

peer_vsx_active_forwarding_vlan_list.description: List of interface VLANs on which the peer device has VSX active-forwarding enabled.

software_update_abort_request.description: Number of times a software update process was requested to be aborted. The abort operation takes effect only when the update operation is in progress.

software_update_schedule_time.description: Time (in seconds from epoch) when the update should be performed. When the software update parameters (URL, VRF, schedule_time[optional] are added/updated, the new image is downloaded to alternate bank of both, primary and secondary. Post download, the secondary is rebooted and then followed by the primary.

bgp_shutdown_ready.description: BGP protocol is ready for system shutdown.

finish_time.description: Time (in seconds from epoch) when software update was completed, successfully or not.

lacp_shutdown_ready.description: LACP protocol is ready for system shutdown.

mgmd_shutdown_ready.description: IGMP and MLD protocol is ready for system shutdown.

ospfv2_shutdown_ready.description: OSPFv2 protocol is ready for system shutdown.

ospfv3_af_shutdown_ready.description: OSPFv3 AF protocol is ready for system shutdown.

ospfv3_shutdown_ready.description: OSPFv3 protocol is ready for system shutdown.

pim_bidir_shutdown_ready.description: PIM BIDIR protocol is ready for system shutdown.

pim_shutdown_ready.description: PIM protocol is ready for system shutdown.

update_state.description: Status of the software update process: 'image_download_started':              Primary/Secondary switch has started the image download. 'image_download_failed':               Image download has failed in Primary/Secondary. 'image_download_complete':             Image download succeeded in Primary/Secondary. 'image_signature_failure':             Downloaded image does not contain signature. 'image_incompatible':                  Downloaded image is not compatible with hardware. 'image_validation_failed':             Downloaded image validation failed due to other reason(e.g. crc mismatch). 'image_installation_failed':           Image installation to alternate bank failed. 'control_plane_shutdown_initiated':    Control plane shutdown initiated. 'control_plane_shutdown_completed':    Control plane is shutdown in preparation for a system reboot. 'reboot_started':                      Downloaded image has installed in alternate bank and reboot started. 'reboot_failed':                       Downloaded image has installed in alternate bank but failed to reboot the switch. 'reboot_waiting_for_secondary':        Primary waits for Secondary to reboot complete after image_download_complete. 'reboot_secondary_completed':          Secondary switch has rebooted with updated image. 'peer_connection_failure':             Switch failed to connect peer switch due to ISL management link is not operational. 'unsupported_state':                   Software update version is not same in both switches. 'timeout':                             Software update exceeded the maximum time limit. 'software_update_not_in_progress':     Software update is not running or user has aboted it.

vrrp_shutdown_ready.description: VRRP protocol is ready for system shutdown.

software_update_url.description: URL for downloading software from connected storage or remote host. TFTP and USB are the only download methods supported.  For pre-staged software upgrade use usb://boot_bank=primary or usb://boot_bank=secondary For remote download, use tftp://tftpserver_address/absolute_path_of_file, tftp server address can be an IPv4, IPv6 or a fully qualified domain address. Example: tftp://15.119.49.148/halon/new_image.swi Example: usb://boot_bank=primary

software_update_vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF that is used for downloading the image. If the VRF is not specified then the default VRF is used.

system_mac.description: System MAC address to be used by L2 control plane protocols  like STP and LACP as their Bridge Identifier. A pair of VSX switches must have the same system MAC. If system MAC is not configured, L2 control plane protocols  will use the VSX Primary device MAC address as their  Bridge Identifier. MAC address will be in xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx format.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)

software_update_schedule_time.description: Time (in seconds from epoch) when the update should be performed. When the software update parameters (URL, VRF, schedule_time[optional] are added/updated, the new image is downloaded to alternate bank of both, primary and secondary. Post download, the secondary is rebooted and then followed by the primary.

software_update_url.description: URL for downloading software from connected storage or remote host. TFTP and USB are the only download methods supported.  For pre-staged software upgrade use usb://boot_bank=primary or usb://boot_bank=secondary For remote download, use tftp://tftpserver_address/absolute_path_of_file, tftp server address can be an IPv4, IPv6 or a fully qualified domain address. Example: tftp://15.119.49.148/halon/new_image.swi Example: usb://boot_bank=primary

software_update_vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF that is used for downloading the image. If the VRF is not specified then the default VRF is used.

system_mac.description: System MAC address to be used by L2 control plane protocols  like STP and LACP as their Bridge Identifier. A pair of VSX switches must have the same system MAC. If system MAC is not configured, L2 control plane protocols  will use the VSX Primary device MAC address as their  Bridge Identifier. MAC address will be in xx:xx:xx:xx:xx:xx format.

properties.description:
Reference Resource: [VSX](#/VSX)
VSX configuration and status. If not configured, VSX functionality is disabled.

config_sync_disable.description: Specifies whether the VSX configuration synchronization is enabled or not.

config_sync_features.description: Feature configurations to be globally synchronized between VSX peers: `aaa`:                  Everything related to aaa. `acl-log-timer`:        Everything related to access-list log timer. 'arp-security' :        ARP SECURITY feature. `bfd-global`:           Enable, disable and remove bfd, enable and disable bfd echo,                         configure transmit and receive intervals, detect multiplier, etc. `bgp`:                  BGP, ip aspath list, community list, prefix list,                         route map configurations. `client-track-ip`:      Global configurations for client IP tracker. `control-plane-acls`:   Control-plane Access-lists `copp-policy`:          CoPP policies. `dcb-global`:           Global configurations for features related to                          Data Center Bridging (DCBx, PFC and ETS).                         Only applicable to 8325 platforms. `dhcp-relay`:           Everything related to DHCP relay. `dhcp-server`:          Everything related to DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 server. `dhcp-snooping`:        Everything related to DHCPv4 and DHCPv6 snooping. `dns`:                  Name servers, host names, etc. `dsm`:                  Distributed services module associated with VRF. `evpn`:                 EVPN related configurations. `firewall-mode`:     Firewall Mode related configurations. `forwarding-mode-global`: forwarding-mode related global configuration. `gbp`:                  gbp related configuration `gbp-acl-global`:       gbp acl applied to global context `hardware-high-capacity-tcam`: Feature configured in high capacity TCAM `ip-ecmp`               Configurations related to IP ECMP `icmp-tcp`:             Configurations related to ICMP and TCP. `internal-vlan-range`:  Configurations related to internal VLAN range. `keychain`:       Everything related to keychain configurations. `l2-vlan-mac-cfg-mode`: L2 VLAN MAC configuration mode.                         Only applicable to 8320 and 8325 platforms. `lldp`:                 Everything related to LLDP. `loop-protect-global`:  Loop-protect global configurations. `mac-lockout`:          mac lockout configurations. `macsec`:           Configurations related to MACsec. `mclag-interfaces`:     Features on multi-chassis LAGs that have to be identical on                         both peers: QoS, LACP, Loop-Protect, LAG description,                         sFlow, STP, Rate-Limits, Vlans, ACLs, etc. `mgmd-global`:          Sync MGMD global configurations. `msdp-global`:          Sync MSDP global configurations. `nd-snooping` :         Everything related to ND snooping. `neighbor` :            Everything related to IPv4 and IPv6 neighbors mostly static neighbors `ospf`:                 OSPF, route map and keychain configurations. `pim`:          Configurations related to PIM. `policy-global`:        Classifier policy applied to the global context. `private-vlan-global`:  Private VLAN global configuration. `rip`:              Everything related to RIP and RIPng configurations. `qos-global`:           DSCP-Maps, CoS-Maps, QoS-Trust. `route-map`:            IP aspath list, community list, prefix list,                         route map configurations. `sflow-global`:         Everything related to sFlow. `snmp`:                 SNMPv3 contexts, SNMPv3 users, SNMP traps, SNMP communities, etc. `ssh`:                  Secure shell configurations. `static-routes`:        Static routes. `stp-global`:           Global (not per-interface) STP configurations. `telnet`:               Telnet server configurations. `time`:                 Everything related to time - NTP, time zone, etc. `udp-forwarder`:        UDP forwarder feature. `vrrp`:                 VRRP configurations, except anything realted to BFD. `vsx-global` :          Sync inter-switch-link timers, Keepalive timers,                         keepalive udp-port, system-mac, split-recovery and                         linkup delay timer. `port-access`:           Configurations related to port-access.

device_role.description: Specifies whether the device will act as primary or secondary for VSX. VSX operation requires one peer switch to be primary and the other secondary. If not configured, then the device will not participate in VSX role election.

isl_port.description:
Reference Resource: [Port](#/Port)
References port to be used as inter switch link. If not configured, then the device will not participate in VSX formation.

hold_time.description: Configures ISL port-flap hold time in seconds.

peer_detect_interval.description: Configures the amount of time in seconds that the device will wait  for ISL interface to link up after a reboot. If the ISL link does  not come up within this time window, the device will declare  itself as split from its peer.

timeout.description: Configures the amount of time to wait for hellos from peer in seconds.

keepalive_peer_ip.description: IPv4/IPv6 address of the peer device. If not configured, keepalive functionality is disabled.

keepalive_src_ip.description: IPv4/IPv6 address of the device. If not configured, keepalive functionality is disabled.

dead_interval.description: Configures the amount of time to wait for keepalive packets from a peer in seconds.

keepalive_udp_port.description: UDP port number of peer device.

keepalive_vrf.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF to be used for keepalive routing. If not configured, then the default VRF is used.
